details.label: Extended Outlook
details.text: Wednesday through Monday. There is a Marginal Risk, or level 1 out of 5, for thunderstorms with damaging wind gusts Wednesday afternoon south of Interstate 70 as a cold front crosses the region. A strong cold front is expected to bring showers and strong wind gusts from 35 to 45 mph across the region on Friday. Areas across the Laurel Highlands and the higher terrain areas of West Virginia could see gusts in excess of 45 mph. Frost or freeze conditions are also possible over the weekend, especially Saturday night.
